aarti.tek: Listen, my Goddess who dwells on the mountain: no one has found your limit.
aarti.pad1: Betel leaf, areca nut, a flag and a coconut have been brought and offered to you. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: A red bodice graces your body, and a saffron tilaka has been applied. Akbar went to you barefoot and offered a golden canopy. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: A temple was built for you on the high mountains, and a town was founded below. Your reign has stood through the Satya, Tretā and Dvāpara ages, and in the Kali age it is greater by a quarter. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Incense, a lamp, food offerings, the āratī and mohanbhog, a sweet, have been offered. The devotee Dhyānū sings the Mother's praises; he has gained the fruit his heart desired. ॥4॥
